description: Opening 'What the model sees' for the 60-exchange chat, flinging it, going back; three times
placeholder_note: PLACEHOLDER, not measured: the emulator job has not run yet. The baselines are nominal budgets, not measurements, so do not gate against them. bench/app/run_frame_bench.sh (and the frame-bench CI job) see this flag and write measured medians instead (keeping margins, min_samples, optional and the note); review and commit those with the perf-rebaseline label.
note: GitHub Actions Android emulator (reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2, API 36 google_apis x86_64, -gpu swiftshader_indirect, animations on). CPU rendering: relative gates only (+50%), for catastrophic regressions; never absolute budgets (R12 §3.4, §3.8). Median of 3 repetitions in one launch. min_frames is set to 90% of the measured frame count by the first rebaseline. Missed-frame-budget and GC counts are gated with a relative margin and an absolute floor (min_abs_tolerance: a few missed frames or GCs pass even against a zero baseline).
